nodes.label: Sangam favicon: custom brand mark, not a default Vite/React template icon. A jagged zigzag/lightning-bolt-shaped polygon in purple (#863bff) forms the outer silhouette; inside, a mask reveals soft blurred gradient blobs in lavender (#ede6ff) and deep purple (#7e14ff) with one cyan-blue (#47bfff) accent blob, giving a glowing abstract gradient-fill effect within the angular outline. Evokes a flash/flow or stylized letterform, fitting a 'confluence/joining' brand identity.
